GrapheneOS has official production support for the following devices:

  • Pixel 10a (stallion)
  • Pixel 10 Pro Fold (rango)
  • Pixel 10 Pro XL (mustang)
  • Pixel 9a (tegu)
  • Pixel Tablet (tangorpro)

The release tags for these devices have official builds and updates met or exceeded by devices starting from Pixel 8 (shiba) through Pixel 10a (stallion):

The following end-of-life devices are no longer supported:

  • Pixel 5a (barbet)
  • Pixel 5 (redfin)
  • Pixel 4a (5G) (bramble)
  • Nexus 6P (angler)
  • Samsung Galaxy S4 (jflte)
